newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle roundup - USDA.

text.p: USDA said trade was quiet late Friday. There were no sales slaughter steers or heifers confirmed at the close.

Inquiry and demand were light. Ice, sleet, snow, wind, rain over most of Kansas created poor travel conditions. Feedlots were current. Sales confirmed last week on 91,900 cattle including 21,200 head or about 23 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
